premise: I invested my $115,000 widow’s inheritance into a high-end yarn dyeing studio with my stepdaughter, but she secretly siphoned every cent into a cryptocurrency wallet and disappeared, leaving me with nothing but empty dye vats; I traced the blockchain trail with a forensic accountant, got a court ruling, and now she hand-winds skeins in my ‘Purl of Perjury’ yarn shop in an apron that says ‘Tangled in Crypto Lies’ and every label prints the fraud docket.
